rationale: b is the spine: probe-first, four key probes each with a trap, a neighbour partial and a hint, plus Show me why explain nodes. c's erroneous-example probes (operation, size after downstaging, why ALND-first is wrong, nerve statement) are grafted as t1-t4 re-tests reached only after a learner takes an explain route, so right-first-time learners get no extra length and each trap is re-tested in a different form. Trap feedback opens 'That is not right' with one line why; old-key naming and sure_notes added; key positions varied and the longest-key cue in r2 removed. c's worked-case opening dropped (ask-before-tell).
lesson: For management segments, a probe-first spine with explain-on-miss nodes wins; graft a second-form (erroneous-example) probe behind the explain node so the re-test costs only learners who missed.
